# BAB I

## KETENTUAN UMUM

#### Pasal 1

Dalam Peraturan Daerah ini yang dimaksud dengan:

1. Daerah adalah Kabupaten Bima.  
2. Pemerintah Daerah adalah Bupati sebagai unsur penyelenggara  pemerintahan daerah yang memimpin pelaksanaan urusan  pemerintahan.  
3. Bupati adalah Bupati Bima.  
4. Dewan Perwakilan Rakyat Daerah Kabupaten Bima yang selanjutnya  disingkat DPRD adalah lembaga perwakilan rakyat daerah yang  berkedudukan sebagai unsur penyelenggara pemerintahan daerah.  
5. Perangkat Daerah adalah unsur pembantu Bupati dan DPRD dalam  penyelenggaraan urusan pemerintahan yang menjadi kewenangan  Daerah.  
6. Anak adalah seseorang yang belum berusia 18 (delapan belas) tahun,  termasuk anak yang masih dalam kandungan.  
7. Hak anak adalah bagian dari hak asasi manusia yang wajib dijamin,  dilindungi, dan dipenuhi oleh orang tua, keluarga, masyarakat,  pemerintah, pemerintah daerah, dan negara.  
8. Perlindungan Anak adalah segala kegiatan untuk menjamin dan  melindungi anak dan hak-haknya agar dapat hidup, tumbuh,  berkembang, dan berpartisipasi secara optimal sesuai dengan harkat dan  martabat kemanusiaan, serta mendapat perlindungan dari kekerasan dan  diskriminasi.  
9. Perlindungan Khusus adalah suatu bentuk perlindungan yang diterima  oleh Anak dalam situasi dan kondisi tertentu untuk mendapatkan  jaminan rasa aman terhadap ancaman yang membahayakan diri dan jiwa  dalam tumbuh kembangnya.  
10. Pemberdayaan Perempuan adalah upaya terstruktur untuk mewujudkan  kesetaraan gender dalam hal akses, partisipasi, kontrol, dan manfaat  dalam pembangunan dan penguasaan sumber daya dalam rangka  peningkatan kualitas hidup dan peningkatan peran perempuan.  
11. Kekerasan adalah setiap perbuatan yang berakibat timbulnya  kesengsaraan dan/atau penderitaan secara fisik, psikis, seksual,  dan/atau penelantaran, termasuk ancamana untuk melakukan  perbuatan, pemaksaan, atau perampasan kemerdekaan secara melawan  hukum.  
12. Forum Anak Daerah yang selanjutnya disebut Forda adalah wadah  partisipasi Anak yang dibentuk dengan tujuan memfasilitasi keterlibatan  anak dalam proses pengambilan keputusan dan menikmati perubahan  yang berkenaan dengan hidup mereka baik secara langsung maupun  tidak langsung, yang dilaksanakan dengan persetujuan dan kemauan  semua anak berdasarkan kesadaran dan pemahaman, sesuai dengan usia  dan tingkat kematangan berpikir.  
13. Unit Pelaksana Teknis Daerah Pemberdayaan Perempuan, Perlindungan  Anak, Pengendalian Penduduk dan Keluarga Berencana yang selanjutnya  disingkat UPTD P3AP2KB adalah unit pelaksana teknis daerah yang  dibentuk pemerintah daerah dalam memberikan layanan bagi perempuan  dan anak yang mengalami kekerasan, diskriminasi, perlindungan khusus, dan masalah lainnya.  
14. Pengarusutamaan gender yang selanjutnya disingkat PUG adalah strategi  yang dibangun untuk mengintegrasikan gender menjadi satu dimensi  integral dari perencanaan, penyusunan, pelaksanaan, pemantauan, dan  evaluasi atas kebijakan dan program pembangunan nasional.  
15. Gender adalah konsep yang mengacu pada peran-peran dan tanggung  jawab laki-laki dan perempuan yang terjadi akibat dari dan dapat  berubah oleh keadaan sosial dan budaya masyarakat.  
16. Perencanaan dan Penganggaran yang Responsif Gender yang selanjutnya  disingkat PPRG adalah instrumen perencanaan dan penganggaran yang  disusun untuk mengakomodasi kebutuhan dan kesulitan yang berbeda  sebagai perempuan dan sebagai laki-laki dengan tujuan untuk  mewujudkan perencanaan dan penganggaran yang berkeadilan dalam  rangka mencapai Kesetaraan Gender dalam pembangunan.  
17. Anggaran Responsif Gender yang selanjutnya disingkat ARG adalah  anggaran yang respon terhadap kebutuhan perempuan dan laki-laki yang  tujuannya untuk mewujudkan kesetaraan dan keadilan gender
18. Kesetaraan gender adalah kesamaan kondisi bagi laki-laki dan  perempuan untuk memperoleh kesempatan dan hak-haknya sebagai  manusia, agar mampu berperan dan berpartisipasi dalam kegiatan  politik, ekonomi, sosial budaya, pertahanan dan keamanan nasional, dan  kesamaan dalam menikmati hasil pembangunan.  
19. Kabupaten Layak Anak yang selanjutnya disingkat KLA adalah kabupaten yang mempunyai sistem pembangunan berbasis hak anak melalui  pengintegrasian komitmen dan sumber daya pemerintah, masyarakat dan  dunia usaha yang terencana secara menyeluruh dan berkelanjutan dalam  kebijakan, program dan kegiatan untuk menjamin terpenuhinya hak  anak.  
20. Pengarusutamaan Hak Anak yang selanjutnya disingkat PUHA adalah  suatu strategi pelaksanaan perlindungan anak dengan mengintegrasikan  hak anak dalam peraturan perundangan, kebijakan, program, kegiatan  dan anggaran mulai dari tahap perencanaan, penyusunan, pelaksanaan,  pemantauan dan evaluasi dengan prinsip kepentingan terbaik bagi anak.  
21. Pengasuhan Anak adalah upaya untuk memenuhi kebutuhan akan kasih  sayang, kelekatan, keselamatan, dan kesejahteraan yang menetap dan  berkelanjutan demi kepentingan terbaik bagi Anak.  
22. Kelompok Kerja Pengarusutamaan Gender yang selanjutnya disebut Pokja  PUG adalah wadah konsultasi bagi pelaksana dan penggerak PUG dari  berbagai instansi atau lembaga di daerah.  
23. Focal Point Pengarusutamaan Gender yang selanjutnya disebut Focal Point PUG adalah aparatur Perangkat Daerah yang mempunyai kemampuan  untuk melakukan PUG di unit kerjanya masing-masing.  
24. Rencana Pembangunan Jangka Menengah Daerah yang selanjutnya  disingkat RPJMD adalah dokumen perencanaan daerah untuk periode 5  (lima) tahun dan mengacu pada Rencana Pembangunan Jangka  Menengah Nasional.  
25. Rencana Kerja Pemerintah Daerah yang selanjutnya disingkat RKPD adalah dokumen perencanaan daerah untuk periode 1 (satu) tahun. 26. Rencana Kerja Perangkat Daerah yang selanjutnya disebut Renja Perangkat Daerah adalah dokumen perencanaan kerja Perangkat Daerah  untuk periode 1 (satu) tahun.  
27. Rencana Aksi Daerah yang selanjutnya disingkat RAD adalah Rencana  Aksi Daerah dalam melaksanakan perlindungan perempuan dan anak.

#### Pasal 2

Penyelenggaraan pemberdayaan perempuan dan perlindungan anak  dilaksanakan berdasarkan asas:
a. penghormatan hak asasi manusia;  
b. kesetaraan gender;  
c. nondiskriminasi;  
d. perlindungan korban;  
e. kepentingan terbaik bagi anak;  
f. kelangsungan hidup dan perkembangan anak;  
g. partisipasi anak; danh. kemanfaatan.

#### Pasal 3

Penyelenggaraan pemberdayaan perempuan dan perlindungan anak bertujuan  untuk:
a. mewujudkan kesempatan dalam akses, partisipasi, kontrol, dan manfaat  dalam pembangunan dan penguasaan sumber daya di Daerah; b. mencegah dan menangani kekerasan, eksploitasi, dan perlakuan yang  bersifat diskriminatif terhadap perempuan dan anak;  
c. meningkatkan kualitas dan peran perempuan dan anak; dan d. tersedianya data untuk perencanaan pemberdayaan perempuan serta  pemenuhan dan perlindungan hak anak.

# BAB II

## KEWENANGAN

#### Pasal 4

1. Penyelenggaraan Pemberdayaan Perempuan dan Perlindungan Anak di  Daerah dilaksanakan oleh Pemerintah Daerah.  
2. Dalam melaksanakan penyelenggaraan Pemberdayaan Perempuan dan  Perlindungan Anak, Bupati berwenang:a. melaksanakan kebijakan Pemberdayaan Perempuan dan Perlindungan  Anak di tingkat kabupaten;  
b. menyediakan sumberdaya manusia yang memiliki perspektif gender  dan hak anak, sarana, prasarana dan infrastruktur yang ramah,  aman, dan nyaman bagi perempuan dan Anak;  
c. melakukan koordinasi dan kerja sama dengan pemangku kepentingan  yang bersifat lintas sektor di Daerah; dand. melakukan pembinaan dan pengawasan teknis di Daerah. (3) Bupati dalam melaksanakan kewenangannya sebagaimana dimaksud  pada ayat (2), dapat menugaskan Sekretaris Daerah atau Perangkat  Daerah yang menyelenggarakan urusan pemerintahan di bidang  Pemberdayaan Perempuan dan Perlindungan Anak Daerah.

# CHAPTER I

## GENERAL PROVISIONS

#### Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

1. Region is Bima Regency.  
2. Regional Government is the Regent as an element of regional government administration who leads the implementation of government affairs.  
3. Regent is the Regent of Bima.  
4. Regional House of Representatives of Bima Regency hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD is a regional people's representative institution positioned as an element of regional government administration.  
5. Regional Apparatus is an auxiliary element of the Regent and DPRD in the administration of government affairs that are the authority of the Region.  
6. Child is a person who has not yet reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a child still in the womb.  
7. Child's rights are part of human rights that must be guaranteed, protected, and fulfilled by parents, family, community, government, regional government, and the state.  
8. Child Protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop, and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and worth, and receive protection from violence and discrimination.  
9. Special Protection is a form of protection received by Children in certain situations and conditions to obtain a guarantee of security against threats that endanger themselves and their lives in their growth and development.  
10. Women's Empowerment is a structured effort to realize gender equality in terms of access, participation, control, and benefits in development and control of resources in order to improve quality of life and enhance the role of women.  
11. Violence is any act that results in misery and/or suffering physically, psychologically, sexually, and/or neglect, including threats to commit acts, coercion, or unlawful deprivation of liberty.  
12. Regional Children's Forum hereinafter referred to as Forda is a forum for Child participation formed with the aim of facilitating children's involvement in decision-making processes and enjoying changes concerning their lives either directly or indirectly, which is carried out with the consent and will of all children based on awareness and understanding, in accordance with age and level of maturity of thinking.  
13. Regional Technical Implementation Unit for Women's Empowerment, Child Protection, Population Control and Family Planning hereinafter abbreviated as UPTD P3AP2KB is a regional technical implementation unit established by the regional government in providing services for women and children who experience violence, discrimination, special protection, and other problems.  
14. Gender mainstreaming hereinafter abbreviated as PUG is a strategy built to integrate gender into an integral dimension of planning, formulation, implementation, monitoring, and evaluation of national development policies and programs.  
15. Gender is a concept that refers to the roles and responsibilities of men and women that occur as a result of and can be changed by the social and cultural circumstances of society.  
16. Gender Responsive Planning and Budgeting hereinafter abbreviated as PPRG is a planning and budgeting instrument prepared to accommodate the different needs and difficulties as women and as men with the aim of realizing just planning and budgeting in order to achieve Gender Equality in development.  
17. Gender Responsive Budget hereinafter abbreviated as ARG is a budget that is responsive to the needs of women and men with the aim of realizing gender equality and justice
18. Gender equality is the equality of conditions for men and women to obtain opportunities and their rights as human beings, so that they are able to play a role and participate in political, economic, socio-cultural, national defense and security activities, and equality in enjoying the results of development.  
19. Child-Friendly Regency hereinafter abbreviated as KLA is a regency that has a child rights-based development system through the integration of government, community and business commitments and resources that are planned comprehensively and sustainably in policies, programs and activities to ensure the fulfillment of children's rights.  
20. Child Rights Mainstreaming hereinafter abbreviated as PUHA is a strategy for implementing child protection by integrating children's rights in legislation, policies, programs, activities and budgets starting from the planning, formulation, implementation, monitoring and evaluation stages with the principle of the best interests of the child.  
21. Child Care is an effort to meet the needs for affection, attachment, safety, and welfare that is permanent and sustainable for the best interests of the Child.  
22. Gender Mainstreaming Working Group hereinafter referred to as Pokja PUG is a consultation forum for implementers and drivers of PUG from various agencies or institutions in the region.  
23. Gender Mainstreaming Focal Point hereinafter referred to as Focal Point PUG is a Regional Apparatus official who has the ability to carry out PUG in their respective work units.  
24. Regional Medium-Term Development Plan hereinafter abbreviated as RPJMD is a regional planning document for a period of 5 (five) years and refers to the National Medium-Term Development Plan.  
25. Regional Government Work Plan hereinafter abbreviated as RKPD is a regional planning document for a period of 1 (one) year. 26. Regional Apparatus Work Plan hereinafter referred to as Renja Regional Apparatus is a work planning document of the Regional Apparatus for a period of 1 (one) year.  
27. Regional Action Plan hereinafter abbreviated as RAD is the Regional Action Plan in implementing the protection of women and children.

#### Article 2

The implementation of women's empowerment and child protection is carried out based on the principles of:
a. respect for human rights;  
b. gender equality;  
c. non-discrimination;  
d. victim protection;  
e. best interests of the child;  
f. survival and development of the child;  
g. child participation; andh. benefit.

#### Article 3

The implementation of women's empowerment and child protection aims to:
a. realize opportunities in access, participation, control, and benefits in development and control of resources in the Region; b. prevent and address violence, exploitation, and discriminatory treatment against women and children;  
c. improve the quality and role of women and children; and d. provide data for planning women's empowerment and fulfillment and protection of children's rights.

# CHAPTER II

## AUTHORITY

#### Article 4

1. The implementation of Women's Empowerment and Child Protection in the Region is carried out by the Regional Government.  
2. In implementing the implementation of Women's Empowerment and Child Protection, the Regent has the authority:a. implement Women's Empowerment and Child Protection policies at the regency level;  
b. provide human resources with gender and child rights perspectives, facilities, infrastructure and infrastructure that are friendly, safe, and comfortable for women and Children;  
c. coordinate and cooperate with stakeholders that are cross-sectoral in nature in the Region; andd. conduct technical guidance and supervision in the Region. (3) The Regent in exercising his/her authority as referred to in paragraph (2), may assign the Regional Secretary or Regional Apparatus that administers government affairs in the field of Women's Empowerment and Regional Child Protection.

# BAB III

## PENYELENGGARAAN

## Bagian Kesatu

Perencanaan

#### Pasal 6

Perencanaan Pemberdayaan Perempuan dan Perlindungan Anak diintegrasikan  ke dalam RPJMD, RKPD, Renja Perangkat Daerah, dan RAD.

## Bagian Kedua

Kualitas Hidup Perempuan

#### Pasal 7

Penyelenggaraan peningkatan Kualitas Hidup perempuan dilakukan dengan  cara:
a. pelembagaan PUG pada lembaga Pemerintah Daerah;  
b. Pemberdayaan Perempuan bidang politik, hukum, sosial, dan ekonomi  pada organisasi kemasyarakatan tingkat Daerah; danc. penguatan dan pengembangan lembaga penyedia layanan Pemberdayaan  Perempuan tingkat Daerah.

#### Pasal 8

Pelembagaan PUG pada lembaga pemerintah sebagaimana dimaksud dalam  Pasal 7 huruf a dilakukan melalui pelaksanaan kebijakan, program, dan  kegiatan yang responsif gender tingkat daerah.

#### Pasal 9

Pemberdayaan Perempuan bidang politik, hukum, sosial, dan ekonomi pada  organisasi kemasyarakatan sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 7 huruf b  dilakukan melalui:
a. peningkatan kualitas dan kuantitas perempuan bidang politik, hukum,  sosial, dan ekonomi pada organisasi kemasyarakatan tingkat daerah; danb. pelibatan perempuan dalam pengambilan keputusan bidang politik,  hukum, sosial, dan ekonomi pada organisasi kemasyarakatan tingkat  daerah.

#### Pasal 10

Penguatan dan pengembangan lembaga penyedia layanan Pemberdayaan  Perempuan sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 7 huruf c dilakukan melalui: a. peningkatan kapasitas sumber daya lembaga penyedia layanan  Pemberdayaan Perempuan tingkat daerah;  
b. pendampingan pelaksanaan layanan Pemberdayaan Perempuan tingkat  daerah;  
c. pengembangan Komunikasi, Informasi, dan Edukasi Pemberdayaan  Perempuan tingkat daerah;  
d. penguatan jejaring antar lembaga penyedia layanan Pemberdayaan  Perempuan tingkat daerah;  
e. fasilitasi pelaksanaan standarisasi lembaga penyedia layanan  Pemberdayaan Perempuan tingkat daerah; danf. pengembangan lembaga penyedia layanan Pemberdayaan Perempuan  tingkat daerah.

## Bagian Ketiga

Perlindungan Perempuan

#### Pasal 11

Penyelenggaraan perlindungan perempuan dilakukan dengan cara: a. pencegahan kekerasan terhadap perempuan yang melibatkan para pihak di  Daerah;  
b. penyediaan layanan bagi perempuan korban kekerasan yang memerlukan  koordinasi antara Perangkat Daerah, Instansi Vertikal, dan lembaga lembaga lain di Daerah; danc. penguatan dan pengembangan lembaga penyedia layanan perlindungan  perempuan di Daerah.

#### Pasal 12

Pencegahan kekerasan terhadap perempuan sebagaimana dimaksud dalam  Pasal 11 huruf a dilakukan melalui:
a. pelaksanaan kebijakan, program dan kegiatan pencegahan kekerasan  terhadap perempuan yang melibatkan para pihak lingkup daerah; b. pemberian edukasi pencegahan kekerasan terhadap perempuan di daerah; c. peningkatan peran serta masyarakat, dunia usaha, dan media dalam  pencegahan kekerasan terhadap perempuan di daerah; dand. pembuatan dan/atau pemanfaatan aplikasi Sistim Informasi Warga dalam  penyampaian laporan kasus kekerasan perempuan dan anak.

#### Pasal 13

Ketentuan lebih lanjut mengenai pembuatan dan/atau pemanfaatan aplikasi  sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 12 huruf d diatur dengan Peraturan  Bupati.

#### Pasal 14

Penyediaan layanan bagi perempuan korban kekerasan sebagaimana  dimaksud dalam Pasal 11 huruf b dilakukan melalui:
a. pelaksanaan penyediaan layanan bagi perempuan korban kekerasan  melalui UPTD P3AP2KB atau unit kerja yang menangani urusan PPA yang  memerlukan koordinasi di daerah;  
b. penyediaan layanan pengaduan masyarakat bagi perempuan korban  kekerasan di daerah;  
c. penyediaan layanan penjangkauan bagi perempuan korban kekerasan di daerah;  
d. penyediaan layanan pengelolaan kasus bagi perempuan korban kekerasan  tingkat daerah kabupaten;  
e. penyediaan layanan penampungan sementara bagi perempuan korban  kekerasan di daerah;  
f. penyediaan layanan mediasi bagi perempuan korban kekerasan di daerah; g. penyediaan layanan pendampingan bagi perempuan korban kekerasan di daerah;  
h. penyediaan sarana dan prasarana layanan bagi perempuan korban  kekerasan di daerah;  
i. penyediaan sarana prasarana informasi yang tersedia di ruang publik; dan  j. mengembangkan sistem darurat responsif terjadinya tindak kekerasan  terhadap perempuan dan anak melalui aplikasi.

#### Pasal 15

Penguatan dan pengembangan lembaga penyedia layanan perlindungan  perempuan sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 11 huruf c dilakukan melalui: a. peningkatan kapasitas sumber penyedia layanan penanganan dan  perlindungan hak perempuan korban kekerasan di daerah;  
b. penyediaan kebutuhan spesifik bagi perempuan dalam situasi darurat dan  kondisi khusus di daerah; danc. pengembangan Komunikasi, Informasi, dan Edukasi perlindungan hak  perempuan di daerah.

## Bagian Keempat

Kualitas Keluarga

#### Pasal 16

Penyelenggaraan peningkatan kualitas keluarga dilakukan dengan cara: a. peningkatan kualitas keluarga dalam mewujudkan kesetaraan gender dan  hak anak;  
b. penguatan dan pengembangan lembaga penyedia layanan peningkatan  kualitas keluarga dalam mewujudkan kesetaraan gender dan hak anak;  danc. penyediaan layanan bagi keluarga dalam mewujudkan kesetaraan gender  dan hak anak.

#### Pasal 17

Peningkatan kualitas keluarga sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 16 huruf a  dilakukan melalui:
a. pelaksanaan kebijakan, program dan kegiatan peningkatan kualitas  keluarga untuk mewujudkan kesetaraan gender dan perlindungan anak di  daerah; danb. pengembangan materi dan pelaksanaan Komunikasi, Informasi, dan  Edukasi kesetaraan gender dan perlindungan anak bagi keluarga di  daerah.

#### Pasal 18

Penguatan dan pengembangan lembaga penyedia layanan peningkatan kualitas  keluarga sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 16 huruf b dilakukan melalui: a. peningkatan kapasitas sumber daya lembaga penyedia layanan  peningkatan kualitas keluarga di daerah;  
b. penguatan jejaring antar lembaga penyedia layanan peningkatan kualitas  keluarga di daerah;  
c. fasilitasi pelaksanaan standarisasi lembaga penyedia layanan peningkatan  kualitas keluarga di daerah; dand. pengembangan lembaga penyedia layanan peningkatan kualitas keluarga di  daerah.

#### Pasal 19

Penyediaan layanan bagi keluarga dalam mewujudkan kesetaraan gender dan  hak anak sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 16 huruf c dilakukan melalui: a. pelaksanaan penyediaan layanan bagi keluarga dalam mewujudkan kesetaraan gender dan perlindungan anak yang wilayah kerjanya di daerah; b. pendampingan pelaksanaan layanan peningkatan kualitas keluarga di  daerah; dan
c. penyediaan sarana dan prasarana layanan bagi keluarga dalam  mewujudkan kesetaraan gender dan perlindungan anak di daerah.

## Bagian Kelima

Sistem Data Gender dan Anak

1. Regional Apparatus that administers governmental affairs in the field of Women's Empowerment and Child Protection in providing services for women and children experiencing problems of violence, discrimination, special protection, and other technical problems shall be implemented by UPTD P3AP2KB.
2. UPTD P3AP2KB as referred to in paragraph (1) shall carry out service functions:
   a. public complaints;
   b. victim outreach;
   c. case management;
   d. temporary shelter;
   e. mediation; and
   f. victim assistance.
3. In the implementation of service functions as referred to in paragraph (2) letter b, a task force for women's empowerment and child protection may be established, facilitated by the Regional Apparatus responsible for Women's Empowerment and Child Protection.
4. Service functions provided by UPTD P3AP2KB as referred to in paragraph (2) shall refer to service standards that have been established in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

# CHAPTER III

## IMPLEMENTATION

## Part One

Planning

#### Article 6

Planning for Women's Empowerment and Child Protection shall be integrated into the RPJMD, RKPD, Regional Apparatus Work Plan, and RAD.

## Part Two

Quality of Life for Women

#### Article 7

Implementation of improving the Quality of Life for women shall be carried out by:

a. institutionalization of PUG in Regional Government institutions;
b. Women's Empowerment in the political, legal, social, and economic fields in community organizations at the Regional level; and
c. strengthening and development of Women's Empowerment service provider institutions at the Regional level.

#### Article 8

Institutionalization of PUG in government institutions as referred to in Article 7 letter a shall be carried out through the implementation of gender-responsive policies, programs, and activities at the regional level.

#### Article 9

Women's Empowerment in the political, legal, social, and economic fields in community organizations as referred to in Article 7 letter b shall be carried out through:

a. improving the quality and quantity of women in the political, legal, social, and economic fields in community organizations at the regional level; and
b. involving women in decision-making in the political, legal, social, and economic fields in community organizations at the regional level.

#### Article 10

Strengthening and development of Women's Empowerment service provider institutions as referred to in Article 7 letter c shall be carried out through:

a. improving the capacity of resources of Women's Empowerment service provider institutions at the regional level;
b. assistance in the implementation of Women's Empowerment services at the regional level;
c. development of Communication, Information, and Education for Women's Empowerment at the regional level;
d. strengthening networks among Women's Empowerment service provider institutions at the regional level;
e. facilitation of the implementation of standardization of Women's Empowerment service provider institutions at the regional level; and
f. development of Women's Empowerment service provider institutions at the regional level.

## Part Three

Protection of Women

#### Article 11

Implementation of protection of women shall be carried out by:

a. prevention of violence against women involving parties in the Region;
b. provision of services for women victims of violence requiring coordination between Regional Apparatus, Vertical Agencies, and other institutions in the Region; and
c. strengthening and development of women's protection service provider institutions in the Region.

#### Article 12

Prevention of violence against women as referred to in Article 11 letter a shall be carried out through:

a. implementation of policies, programs and activities for the prevention of violence against women involving parties within the regional scope;
b. provision of education on the prevention of violence against women in the region;
c. increasing the participation of the community, business sector, and media in the prevention of violence against women in the region; and
d. creation and/or utilization of Citizen Information System applications in submitting reports of cases of violence against women and children.

#### Article 13

Further provisions regarding the creation and/or utilization of applications as referred to in Article 12 letter d shall be regulated by Regent Regulation.

#### Article 14

Provision of services for women victims of violence as referred to in Article 11 letter b shall be carried out through:

a. implementation of service provision for women victims of violence through UPTD P3AP2KB or work units handling PPA affairs requiring coordination in the region;
b. provision of public complaint services for women victims of violence in the region;
c. provision of outreach services for women victims of violence in the region;
d. provision of case management services for women victims of violence at the district regional level;
e. provision of temporary shelter services for women victims of violence in the region;
f. provision of mediation services for women victims of violence in the region;
g. provision of assistance services for women victims of violence in the region;
h. provision of service facilities and infrastructure for women victims of violence in the region;
i. provision of information infrastructure available in public spaces; and
j. developing an emergency response system for acts of violence against women and children through applications.

#### Article 15

Strengthening and development of women's protection service provider institutions as referred to in Article 11 letter c shall be carried out through:

a. improving the capacity of service providers for handling and protecting the rights of women victims of violence in the region;
b. provision of specific needs for women in emergency situations and special conditions in the region; and
c. development of Communication, Information, and Education for the protection of women's rights in the region.

## Part Four

Family Quality

#### Article 16

Implementation of improving family quality shall be carried out by:

a. improving family quality in realizing gender equality and children's rights;
b. strengthening and development of service provider institutions for improving family quality in realizing gender equality and children's rights; and
c. provision of services for families in realizing gender equality and children's rights.

#### Article 17

Improving family quality as referred to in Article 16 letter a shall be carried out through:

a. implementation of policies, programs and activities for improving family quality to realize gender equality and child protection in the region; and
b. development of materials and implementation of Communication, Information, and Education on gender equality and child protection for families in the region.

#### Article 18

Strengthening and development of service provider institutions for improving family quality as referred to in Article 16 letter b shall be carried out through:

a. improving the capacity of resources of service provider institutions for improving family quality in the region;
b. strengthening networks among service provider institutions for improving family quality in the region;
c. facilitation of the implementation of standardization of service provider institutions for improving family quality in the region; and
d. development of service provider institutions for improving family quality in the region.

#### Article 19

Provision of services for families in realizing gender equality and children's rights as referred to in Article 16 letter c shall be carried out through:

a. implementation of service provision for families in realizing gender equality and child protection whose working area is in the region;
b. assistance in the implementation of family quality improvement services in the region; and
c. provision of service facilities and infrastructure for families in realizing gender equality and child protection in the region.

## Part Five

Gender and Child Data System

#### Article 20

1. The Regional Government develops a database and information system for gender and child data that is integrated with the provincial government and the central government.  
2. In developing the database and information system for gender and child data as referred to in paragraph (1), the Regional Government provides human resources and facilities and infrastructure.  
3. The implementation of the Gender and Child Data System is carried out by means of collecting, processing, analyzing, and presenting gender and child data within the data institution in the Region.

#### Article 21

The implementation of the Gender and Child Data System as referred to in Article 20 paragraph (3) is carried out through:

a. provision of gender and child data in the region;  
b. presentation and utilization of gender and child data within the data institution at the regional level; dan  
c. implementation of the gender and child data system refers to the guidelines that have been established in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

## Part Six

Fulfillment of Children's Rights

#### Article 22

The implementation of the fulfillment of children's rights is carried out by means of: a. institutionalization of the fulfillment of children's rights in government institutions, non-government institutions, media, and the business sector in the Region; and
b. strengthening and development of service provider institutions for improving the quality of life of children at the Regional level.

#### Article 23

The institutionalization of the fulfillment of children's rights as referred to in Article 22 letter a is carried out through:

a. implementation of policies, programs, and activities for the fulfillment of children's rights in efforts to prevent violations of children's rights in the region;  
b. increasing participation and the role of children's forums or the like in the region; c. facilitating the strengthening of institutions and resources of government institutions, non-government institutions, media, and the business sector in the region;  
d. facilitating the strengthening of networks among government institutions, non-government institutions, media, and the business sector in the region; dan  
e. strengthening cross-institutional cooperation among government institutions, non-government institutions, media, and the business sector to realize Child-Friendly Regency (KLA), Child-Friendly Sub-district (Kelana), and Child-Friendly Village (Dela).

#### Article 24

The strengthening and development of service provider institutions for improving the quality of life of children as referred to in Article 22 letter b is carried out through: a. capacity building of resources of service provider institutions for improving the quality of life of children in the region;  
b. assistance in the implementation of services for improving the quality of life of children in the region;  
c. development of materials and implementation of Communication, Information, and Education on the fulfillment of children's rights for service provider institutions for improving the quality of life of children in the region;  
d. strengthening networks among service provider institutions for improving the quality of life of children in the region;  
e. facilitation of the implementation of standardization of service provider institutions for improving the quality of life of children in the region; danf. development of service provider institutions for improving the quality of life of children in the region.

## Part Seven

Special Protection of Children

#### Article 25

The implementation of Special Protection of Children is carried out by means of: a. prevention of violence against children;  
b. provision of services for children who require special protection through coordination of parties, both government and non-government institutions, in the Region; danc. strengthening and development of service provider institutions for children who require special protection in the Region.

#### Article 26

The prevention of violence against children as referred to in Article 25 letter a is carried out through:

a. implementation of policies, programs, and activities for the prevention of violence against children who require special protection involving government and non-government institutions in the region;  
b. provision of education on the prevention of violence against children who require special protection in the region;  
c. increasing community participation through the Community-Based Integrated Child Protection (PATBM) movement, the business sector, media, and children in the prevention of violence in the region; dand. strengthening cooperation to realize Child-Friendly Regency (KLA), Child-Friendly Sub-district (Kelana), and Child-Friendly Village (Dela).

#### Article 27

The provision of services for children who require special protection as referred to in Article 25 letter b is carried out through: a. implementation of the provision of services for children who require special protection through the Regional Apparatus that handles the affairs of Women's Empowerment and Child Protection and/or UPTD P3AP2KB in the region;  
b. provision of public complaint services for children who require special protection in the region;  
c. provision of outreach services for children who require special protection in the region;  
d. provision of case management services for children who require special protection in the region;  
e. provision of temporary shelter services for children who require special protection in the region;  
f. provision of mediation services for children who require special protection in the region;  
g. provision of assistance services for children who require special protection in the region; danh. provision of facilities and infrastructure for services for children who require special protection in the region.

#### Article 28

The strengthening and development of service provider institutions for children who require special protection as referred to in Article 25 letter c is carried out through:

a. capacity building of resources of service provider institutions for protection and handling of children who require special protection in the region;  
b. provision of specific needs for children in emergency situations and special conditions in the region;  
c. provision of Communication, Information, and Education on the protection of children who require special protection in the region;  
d. strengthening networks among service provider institutions for the protection of children who require special protection in the region; and  
e. facilitation of the implementation of standardization of service provider institutions for the protection of children who require special protection in the region.

# CHAPTER IV

## GENDER MAINSTREAMING

#### Article 29

1. The implementation of Women's Empowerment is carried out through PUG.  
2. The implementation of PUG as referred to in paragraph (1) is carried out by means of integrating gender in the process of planning, formulation, implementation, monitoring, and evaluation of policies, programs, and development activities of the Regional Government that produce ARG.  
3. Policies, programs, and development activities of the Regional Government with a gender perspective as referred to in paragraph (2) are included in the RPJMD, Strategic Plan (Renstra) of Regional Apparatus, and Renja SKPD.

#### Article 30

1. The Regent is responsible for the implementation of PUG in the Region. (2) The Regent establishes the Regional Apparatus that administers governmental affairs in the field of women's empowerment and child protection as the coordinator of the implementation of PUG in the Region.  
3. The success of the implementation of PUG by implementing Gender Responsive Planning and Budgeting (PPRG) is measured through human development indicators, gender development indicators, and gender empowerment indicators in development.  
4. The Regent conducts periodic evaluation of the implementation of PUG every year according to their authority to determine the achievements of the implementation of PUG.

#### Article 31

1. In an effort to accelerate the implementation of PUG, institutional strengthening of PUG is carried out by forming Pokja PUG and Focal Point PUG. (2) Pokja PUG as referred to in paragraph (1) is a means of coordination for the PUG driving agency and consultation for implementers from various agencies and institutions in the Region whose members consist of all heads of Regional Apparatus.  
3. Focal Point PUG as referred to in paragraph (1) is an apparatus of the Regional Apparatus who has the ability and expertise to carry out PUG in their respective work units.

#### Article 32

Further provisions regarding PUG are regulated by a Regent Regulation.

# BAB V

## KABUPATEN LAYAK ANAK

#### Pasal 33

1. Pemerintah Daerah untuk pemenuhan hak Anak dan perlindungan  khusus Anak dapat menyelenggarakan KLA.  
2. Penyelenggaraan KLA sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) menjadi  tanggung jawab Bupati.  
3. Bupati menunjuk Perangkat Daerah yang menyelenggarakan urusan  pemberdayaan perempuan dan Perlindungan Anak sebagai koordinator  penyelenggaraan KLA.

#### Pasal 34

Penyelenggaraan KLA sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 33 ayat (1)  dilaksanakan dalam 5 (lima) tahap yaitu:
a. perencanaan KLA;  
b. praKLA;  
c. Rencana Aksi Daerah KLA;  
d. pelaksanaan KLA; dane. evaluasi KLA.

#### Pasal 35

1. Pada tahap perencanaan KLA, Pemerintah Daerah mewujudkan  komitmennya dengan melakukan deklarasi KLA, pembentukan Gugus  Tugas KLA, dan penyusunan profil KLA.  
2. Pengaturan mengenai pembentukan Gugus Tugas KLA sebagaimana  dimaksud pada ayat (1) ditetapkan dengan Keputusan Bupati. (3) Penyusunan profil KLA sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) berisi data  dan informasi yang mencerminkan kondisi pelaksanaan indikator KLA di  Daerah serta ukurannya.

#### Pasal 36

1. Pada tahap Pra-KLA, Pemerintah Daerah melakukan penilaian mandiri  terhadap profil KLA untuk mengetahui status KLA Daerah sebelum  memulai penyelenggaraan KLA.  
2. Penilaian mandiri sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) didasarkan pada  capaian terhadap 24 (dua puluh empat) Indikator KLA yang masuk dalam  kelembagaan dan 5 (lima) klaster KLA yang telah ditetapkan, yaitu: a. kelembagaan;  
b. klaster hak sipil dan kebebasan;  
c. klaster lingkungan keluarga dan pengasuhan alternatif;  
d. klaster kesehatan dasar dan kesejahteraan;  
e. klaster pendidikan, pemanfaatan waktu luang, dan kegiatan budaya;  danf. klaster perlindungan khusus.  
3. Penilaian mandiri sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dilakukan dengan  mengacu kepada pedoman sesuai ketentuan peraturan perundang undangan.

#### Pasal 37

1. Dalam penyelenggaraan KLA, Pemerintah Daerah melakukan pengintegrasian kebijakan, program, dan kegiatan pembangunan dalam  RAD.  
2. Penyusunan RAD sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) sesuai ketentuan  peraturan perundang-undangan.

#### Pasal 38

Tahap pelaksanaan KLA dilakukan berdasarkan RAD yang telah disusun dengan mengoptimalkan peran Gugus Tugas KLA dan melakukan  pemantauan.

#### Pasal 39

Bupati melakukan evaluasi penyelenggaraan KLA secara berkala setiap tahun  sesuai kewenangannya untuk mengetahui capaian penyelenggaraan KLA.

#### Pasal 40

Ketentuan lebih lanjut mengenai penyelenggaraan KLA diatur dengan  Peraturan Bupati.

# BAB VI

## PENGASUHAN

#### Pasal 41

1. Setiap Anak di Daerah yang tidak terjamin tumbuh kembangnya atau  tidak terpenuhi kebutuhannya atau mengalami penelantaran dari  orangtua, wali, atau keluarga secara wajar, baik fisik, mental, spiritual, maupun sosial, berhak mendapatkan pengasuhan.  
2. Pengasuhan yang dilaksanakan sebagai akibat dari pemisahan Anak  dilakukan demi kepentingan terbaik bagi anak.  
3. Dalam hal pemisahan Anak dilakukan kepentingan terbaik bagi anak,  Pengasuhan harus dilakukan oleh Lembaga Asuhan Anak dengan  persyaratan sesuai dengan ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan.

#### Pasal 42

1. Fasilitasi pengasuhan anak oleh lembaga asuhan anak dilaksanakan oleh  perangkat daerah yang membidangi perempuan dan anak, sosial,  ketenagakerjaan, pendidikan, kesehatan, perencanaan, dan perangkat  daerah lainnya sesuai kebutuhan.  
2. Fasilitasi Pengasuhan Anak sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dapat  dilakukan di luar Panti Sosial atau di dalam Panti Sosial sesuai dengan  ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan.

# BAB VII

## PEMBINAAN DAN PENGAWASAN

#### Pasal 43

1. Pembinaan dan pengawasan terhadap pelaksanaan penyelenggaraan  pemberdayaan perempuan dan perlindungan anak dilaksanakan oleh  Bupati.  
2. Pembinaan dan pengawasan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1)  dikoordinasikan oleh inspektorat Daerah.  
3. Pembinaan dan pengawasan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dan  ayat (2) dilaksanakan dalam bentuk audit, reviu, monitoring, evaluasi,  pemantauan, dan bimbingan teknis, serta bentuk pembinaan dan  pengawasan lainnya.  
4. Pembinaan dan pengawasan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1), ayat  (2), dan ayat (3) dilaksanakan sejak tahap perencanaan, penganggaran,  pengorganisasian, pelaksanaan, pelaporan, evaluasi, dan  pertanggungjawaban penyelenggaraan Pemerintahan Daerah.  
5. Pengawasan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dilaksanakan paling  sedikit 1 (satu) kali dalam 1 (satu) tahun.  
6. Hasil pengawasan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) merupakan  bahan evaluasi bagi kebijakan program pemberdayaan perempuan dan  perlindungan anak di Daerah.

# BAB VIII

## PERAN SERTA MASYARAKAT

#### Pasal 44

1. Masyarakat, Keluarga dan/ atau orang tua dapat berperan serta dalam  penyelenggaraan pemberdayaan perempuan dan perlindungan anak. (2) Masyarakat sebagaimana dimaksud dalam ayat (1) dilakukan secara  perorangan maupun kelembagaan.  
3. Peran serta Masyarakat sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) antara lain  dilakukan dengan cara:a. membentuk unit pemberdayaan dan perlindungan anak di dalam  organisasi kemasyarakatan, perlindungan anak yang berbasis  masyarakat, atau organisasi profesi;  
b. melakukan sosialisasi tentang pemberdayaan perempuan, pencegahan  kekerasan bagi perempuan dan anak serta perlindungan anak; c. melakukan pencegahan terjadinya tindak kekerasan dalam lingkungan  masyarakat; dand. memberikan informasi dan/atau melaporkan terjadinya kekerasan,  diskriminasi, eksploitasi, dan pelanggaran hak asasi terhadap  perempuan dan Anak kepada pihak yang berwenang apabila di  lingkungannya terjadi kekerasan terhadap perempuan dan Anak;  
e. mengoptimalkan fungsi organisasi masyarakat seperti PKK, lembaga  layanan terpadu perlindungan perempuan dan anak di Daerah; f. melakukan sosialisasi dan edukasi peraturan perundang-undangan  terkait pemberdayaan perempuan, perlindungan perempuan dan  Anak, seperti pencegahan perkawinan di bawah tangan dan bahaya  perkawinan usia anak;  
g. memberikan masukan dalam proses penyusunan peraturan  perundang-undangan di daerah;  
h. melarang terjadinya perkawinan di bawah tangan;  
i. menyediakan ruang untuk berkumpul dan berorganisasi bagi Anak  untuk berekspresi dan menyampaikan pendapatnya; danj. mengawasi Anak dalam mengakses berbagai informasi.

# BAB IX

## PENDANAAN

#### Pasal 45

Pendanaan penyelenggaraan pemberdayaan perempuan dan perlindungan  anak yang menjadi kewenangan pemerintah daerah bersumber dari: a. Anggaran Pendapatan dan Belanja Daerah; dan
b. sumber lain yang sah dan tidak mengikat sesuai dengan ketentuan  peraturan perundang-undangan.

# BAB X

## KETENTUAN PERALIHAN

#### Pasal 46

Pada saat Peraturan Daerah ini berlaku, semua ketentuan yang mengatur  mengenai perempuan dan anak dinyatakan tetap berlaku sepanjang tidak  bertentangan dengan ketentuan sebagaimana diatur dalam Peraturan Daerah  ini.

# BAB XI

## KETENTUAN PENUTUP

#### Pasal 47

Peraturan Daerah ini mulai berlaku pada tanggal diundangkan. Agar setiap orang mengetahuinya, memerintahkan pengundangan Peraturan  Daerah ini dengan penempatannya dalam Lembaran Daerah Kabupaten Bima.

# CHAPTER V

## CHILD-FRIENDLY REGENCY

#### Article 33

1. The Regional Government may organize CFC for the fulfillment of Children's rights and special protection of Children.  
2. The organization of CFC as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be the responsibility of the Regent.  
3. The Regent shall appoint the Regional Apparatus that administers the affairs of women's empowerment and Child Protection as the coordinator for the organization of CFC.

#### Article 34

The organization of CFC as referred to in Article 33 paragraph (1) shall be implemented in 5 (five) stages, namely:

a. CFC planning;  
b. pre-CFC;  
c. Regional Action Plan for CFC;  
d. CFC implementation; and  
e. CFC evaluation.

#### Article 35

1. At the CFC planning stage, the Regional Government shall realize its commitment by conducting a CFC declaration, establishing a CFC Task Force, and preparing a CFC profile.  
2. Regulations regarding the establishment of the CFC Task Force as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be stipulated by Regent's Decree.  
3. The preparation of the CFC profile as referred to in paragraph (1) shall contain data and information that reflects the conditions of implementation of CFC indicators in the Region and their measurements.

#### Article 36

1. At the Pre-CFC stage, the Regional Government shall conduct a self-assessment of the CFC profile to determine the Regional CFC status before commencing the organization of CFC.  
2. The self-assessment as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be based on the achievement of 24 (twenty-four) CFC Indicators included in the institutional and 5 (five) CFC clusters that have been established, namely:

a. institutional;  
b. cluster of civil rights and freedoms;  
c. cluster of family environment and alternative care;  
d. cluster of basic health and welfare;  
e. cluster of education, leisure time utilization, and cultural activities; and  
f. cluster of special protection.  
3. The self-assessment as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be conducted by referring to guidelines in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

#### Article 37

1. In organizing CFC, the Regional Government shall integrate development policies, programs, and activities in the RAD.  
2. The preparation of RAD as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

#### Article 38

The CFC implementation stage shall be carried out based on the RAD that has been prepared by optimizing the role of the CFC Task Force and conducting monitoring.

#### Article 39

The Regent shall conduct periodic evaluations of the organization of CFC every year according to their authority to determine the achievements of CFC organization.

#### Article 40

Further provisions regarding the organization of CFC shall be regulated by Regent's Regulation.

# CHAPTER VI

## CARE

#### Article 41

1. Every Child in the Region whose growth and development is not guaranteed or whose needs are not fulfilled or who experiences neglect by parents, guardians, or family in an improper/unreasonable manner, whether physical, mental, spiritual, or social, shall have the right to receive care.  
2. Care that is implemented as a result of Child separation shall be carried out in the best interests of the child.  
3. In the event that Child separation is carried out in the best interests of the child, Care must be carried out by a Child Care Institution with requirements in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

#### Article 42

1. Facilitation of child care by child care institutions shall be implemented by regional apparatus in charge of women and children, social affairs, manpower, education, health, planning, and other regional apparatus as needed.  
2. Facilitation of Child Care as referred to in paragraph (1) may be carried out outside the Social Home or inside the Social Home in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

# CHAPTER VII

## GUIDANCE AND SUPERVISION

#### Article 43

1. Guidance and supervision of the implementation of women's empowerment and child protection organization shall be carried out by the Regent.  
2. Guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be coordinated by the Regional Inspectorate.  
3. Guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) and paragraph (2) shall be implemented in the form of audits, reviews, monitoring, evaluation, oversight, and technical guidance, as well as other forms of guidance and supervision.  
4. Guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1), paragraph (2), and paragraph (3) shall be implemented from the planning, budgeting, organizing, implementation, reporting, evaluation, and accountability stages of Regional Government administration.  
5. Supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be implemented at least 1 (one) time in 1 (one) year.  
6. The results of supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) shall constitute evaluation material for women's empowerment and child protection program policies in the Region.

# CHAPTER VIII

## COMMUNITY PARTICIPATION

#### Article 44

1. The community, Family and/or parents may participate in the organization of women's empowerment and child protection.  
2. The community as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be carried out individually or institutionally.  
3. Community participation as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be carried out, among others, by:

a. establishing women's empowerment and child protection units within community organizations, community-based child protection, or professional organizations;  
b. conducting socialization regarding women's empowerment, prevention of violence against women and children, and child protection;  
c. conducting prevention of acts of violence in the community environment; and  
d. providing information and/or reporting the occurrence of violence, discrimination, exploitation, and human rights violations against women and Children to the competent authorities if violence against women and Children occurs in their environment;  
e. optimizing the function of community organizations such as PKK, integrated service institutions for the protection of women and children in the Region;  
f. conducting socialization and education on laws and regulations related to women's empowerment, protection of women and Children, such as prevention of unregistered marriages and the dangers of child marriage;  
g. providing input in the process of formulating laws and regulations in the region;  
h. prohibiting the occurrence of unregistered marriages;  
i. providing space for Children to gather and organize to express themselves and convey their opinions; and  
j. supervising Children in accessing various information.

Selain itu UUD 1945 juga telah mengamanatkan dalam Pasal 28D ayat  (1) bahwa setiap orang berhak atas pengakuan, jaminan, perlindungan dan  kepastian hukum yang adil serta perlakuan yang sama dihadapan hukum. The 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia mandates Regional Governments to regulate and manage their own regions for the realization of community welfare through improved services, empowerment and community participation. One of the authorities of regional governments is to make regional policies with the aim of improving the welfare of the people in their regions.

In addition, the 1945 Constitution has also mandated in Article 28D paragraph (1) that every person has the right to recognition, guarantees, protection and fair legal certainty as well as equal treatment before the law. This shows that girls should be protected by the state, especially against violence because their rights are already regulated in the constitution.

Therefore, it is necessary to make efforts to prevent and eradicate all forms of discrimination and violence against women and children, especially for the Region. The Region is one of the most authorized parties in carrying out women's empowerment and child protection by implementing and formulating regulations to provide guarantees for women's empowerment and child protection.
